thread:
evan.design: quick ping for design + a11y on the new completion toast. Dark-console mock attached. CTA: 'Open results'. Needs SR announcement, keyboard handoff rules, contrast, and copy check. Minimal placement: bottom-right.

mira.a11y: If toast is interactive, don't rely only on aria-live. Since this toast follows a user click (Run), moving focus into the toast is acceptable. Save the triggering element and restore focus on close. Include a visually-hidden prefix like 'Notification:' and set aria-atomic='true'.

dan.frontend: Plan: toast appears after Run, auto-dismiss 9s, Esc closes. We'll focus the primary button on show. Toast container will be tabindex='-1' to support focusing without trapping.

mira.a11y: Contrast: mock uses bg #0e0e11 and text #e7e7e7 (~4.2:1). Please update copy color to #fafafa for >=4.5:1. CTA label on CTA bg also needs checking. Ensure focus ring has >=3:1 contrast.

lily.pm: Copy suggestion: 'Result ready — Summarizer v2' with CTA 'Open results'. Keep text concise. Add an SR-only hint: 'Press Enter to open'.

owen.eng: Implementation notes: we will not auto-focus toasts that arrive from background processes. Key rule: only auto-focus when the user action triggered the toast. We'll add keydown handler scoped to the toast for Enter to activate primary action, avoid global bindings.

dan.frontend: Skiplinks: header contains 'Skip to notifications' and 'Skip to content'. Make skiplinks visible on keyboard focus (visible-on-focus pattern). If a user uses the notifications skiplink, it should land in the notifications region, not hijack focus into an ephemeral toast.

mira.a11y: Right. Also animations: keep fade/slide under 200ms and respect prefers-reduced-motion. For screen readers aria-live='polite' is fine as backup. For immediate actions you'd use role='alert'.

dan.frontend: I'll add automated tests: unit test for focus restore, accessibility test asserting the sr-only prefix and aria-atomic present, and an e2e keyboard run -> toast flow. Will include axe contrast check in CI.

lily.pm: Thanks. Evan, update Figma with #fafafa body copy and clear focus outline. Tag Mira when updated. Keeping thread open until PR merges. :white_check_mark:
